name: Actions
description: Holds multiple interactive elements.

name: Alert
description: Displays alerts, warnings, and informational messages.

name: Card
description: Displays content in a card.

name: Carousel
description: Displays related card blocks in a horizontally-scrolling container.

name: Container
description: A general-purpose wrapper for grouping child blocks together, with a configurable size.

name: Context
description: Provides contextual info, which can include both images and text.

name: Context actions
description: Displays actions as contextual info, which can include both feedback buttons and icon buttons.

name: Data table
description: Displays rich tables that support pagination, sorting, filtering, and interactivity.

name: Data visualization
description: Displays data visually in pie, bar, area, or line chart formats.

name: Divider
description: Visually separates pieces of info inside of a message.

name: File
description: Displays info about remote files.

name: Header
description: Displays a larger-sized text.

name: Image
description: Displays an image.

name: Input
description: Collects information from users via elements.

name: Markdown
description: Displays formatted markdown.

name: Plan
description: Displays a collection of related tasks.

name: Rich text
description: Displays formatted, structured representation of text.

name: Section
description: Displays text, possibly alongside elements.

name: Table
description: Displays structured information in a table.

name: Task card
description: Displays a single task, representing a single action.

name: Video
description: Displays an embedded video player.
